review.headline: 17 km long run completed steadily at 5:50/km, inside the easy band and matching the plan's intent.
observations: Distance 17.02 km vs 17.0 planned; all 17 km splits were a flat 5:50/km, showing good pace control.
Avg HR 143 with max 146 stayed low and even across the run, consistent with an unhurried aerobic effort.
Pace sits within the 5:11-6:13/km easy band, near the middle-to-faster end, and is in line with the recent easy runs (5:44-5:48/km).
No fuelling or RPE data was logged, so the race-day fuelling instruction cannot be assessed from this file.
flags: RPE and athlete note were not recorded for this run, so subjective effort is unknown.
Week 2 completed 5 of 7 sessions and the previous tempo run was cut short at 6 km with RPE 8, so the recent load context is mixed.
